Slot.description:
Root identifier (A/B). Its one spelling (`A`, `B`) is used by the CLI
and the JSON.

boot_default.description:
The root the boot loader starts by default: the one that last
finished starting. `None` when the default names neither root.

next_boot_once.description: The root picked for the next boot only, if any.

other.description: The other root: unlocked (read-write); changes go there.

other_bootable.description:
The other root has a boot entry whose files are on the ESP, so it
can be started. `false` after a copy that did not finish.

other_mount.description: Where the other root is mounted; `None` when it is not mounted.
